stock.description: Weilong Delicious Global Holdings Ltd. is a company dedicated to the manufacturing and marketing of spicy snack foods. Its product range is extensive, including seasoned flour-based items, various vegetable products, and bean-derived snacks, alongside other offerings. The enterprise was founded in Luohe, China, in 2001, where its headquarters remain. Currently, Weilong operates as a subsidiary of Hh Global Capital Ltd.
